description: SessionStart tells a Happy (phone) session, once at the top, that a localhost address is not something its user can open, that the app has to go through `mp` first, that credentials go through `mp secret` rather than the chat, and that a decision too big to answer in the chat goes through `mp interaction`. No matcher: every way a session can start — startup, resume, clear, compact — needs the same warning, and a new source should not silently lose it. It also writes down whether this session is a phone session, so the two hooks that fire later can read the answer instead of working it out again. Prints nothing in a local session. The Bash|PowerShell PreToolUse refuses the crudest ways an `mp secret run` could be turned into a dump of its own environment; it is the one control that still holds in bypassPermissions mode. The same script, on Bash|PowerShell and on the file tools, keeps the AI off config files mp rendered with real values in them and off the vault's key. The AskUserQuestion PreToolUse catches a question too large to answer in a chat before it is asked, and Stop catches the long write-up that ends in a question after the fact — the first is precise, the second is the only one that works on a host whose model writes such questions as prose instead of calling a tool.
